US Tightens Visa Rules Targeting 'Birth Tourism'

The United States is implementing stricter visa regulations aimed at curbing 'birth tourism,' a practice where individuals travel to the US to obtain citizenship for their children. The Trump administration announced targeted visa sanctions against individuals involved in or facilitating commercial birth tourism. This action includes measures against those who assist in fraudulent marriages or fake jobs to gain entry. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated the move is intended to prevent fraud and has launched an online mechanism for reporting visa fraud.
